name: Ultimate Internet Wrestling Application
notes: UIW's own founding recruitment/rules document: 30 singles/10 tag maximum roster, the TNM6.2 simulator, a September 1997 launch schedule (Championship Weekend: a 30-man battle royal for the World/North American titles). Full staff masthead: President, Vice President, Talent Coordinator, Webmaster and two Card Writers (the latter two, 'Calgary Hitman' and 'AJ Black', read as handles/personas and stand).

name: UIW BIG ANNOUNCEMENT
notes: Announces UIW's five-person announcing team (redacted; real out-of-character names conscripted by the fed's president) and a trademark-style naming dispute: four wrestlers ordered to change gimmick names echoing other federations' own real stars, or be released.

name: Ultimate Internet Wrestling (Special Report)
notes: The planned September Championship Weekend 'did not go on as planned'; announces an October 1 Championship Coronation (30-man World Title battle royal, World Tag Team first-round matches) and discloses five wrestlers quit the original roster without notice.

name: IT'S THE RETURN OF ULTIMATE INTERNET WRESTLING!
notes: UIW's own relaunch announcement and full October schedule (Thursday THUNDER, Saturday Night Showdown, a Madison Square Garden World Tag Team and North American title tournament final on 18 October). No result of this schedule survives in the held record's 1997 holdings -- the fed's own self-narrated instability arc (a planned launch, then a stall, then a relaunch) ends here, the last dated post under this tag.
